mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, dataset_uuid, version_uuid, position, name, description, CAST(turns AS text) AS turns_json, CAST(checkpoints AS text) AS checkpoints_json, CAST(input_files AS text) AS input_files_json, CAST(reference_files AS text) AS reference_files_json, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_cases ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, dataset_uuid, version_uuid, position, name, description, turns, checkpoints, input_files, reference_files, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.DatasetUUID}, #{params.VersionUUID}, #{params.Position}, #{params.Name}, #{params.Description}, CAST(#{params.TurnsJSON} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.CheckpointsJSON} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.InputFilesJSON} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.ReferenceFilesJSON} AS jsonb), #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
